name: Kulipari: United
description:
About This Game

Kulipari: United is a cooperative 3D beat ’em up that brings the vibrant amphibian world of Kulipari to life with high-energy melee combat with cinematic visuals. 

Battle through a story-driven PvE campaign filled with platforming combat and a dynamic camera system that follows the action from every angle. Then jump into Arena VS Mode—fast, chaotic PvP battles set in condition-based arenas where skill, mobility, and teamwork decide the victor. Play your way: single-player, co-op, PvE, PvP, online or local.

Fight solo or team up with friends in online or couch co-op as you defend the frogs’ homeland from invading scorpions, spiders, and lizards. Journey across dangerous regions and face powerful foes in a campaign that bridges the animated universe with an all-new interactive storyline—all brought to life through a dynamic camera system that adapts to every battle.

Arena Mode is Kulipari: United’s dedicated PvP experience — fast-paced, skill-driven combat where players face off in compact, condition-based arenas. Each stage introduces unique platforming challenges, environmental twists, hazards, or shifting objectives that force you to adapt on the fly. Play solo against AI opponents or jump into multiplayer battles—online or local—for head-to-head or free-for-all matchups. Whether you're looking for competitive PvP duels, training in single-player, or taking a break from the story-driven PvE campaign, Arena Mode delivers high-energy fights built for mastery, replayability, and pure combat chaos.

  • Single-Player or Multiplayer: Play solo or team up with friends in local or online multiplayer for up to four players.

  • Story-Driven Campaign (PvE): Defend the frogs’ homeland in a cinematic adventure that expands the Kulipari universe.

  • Arena VS Mode (PvP): Compete in fast-paced duels and free-for-all battles across condition-based arenas with shifting hazards and objectives.

  • Platforming Combat: Leap, dodge, and strike through layered environments that test agility as much as combat skill.

  • Unique Playable Warriors: Choose from a roster of Kulipari heroes, each with distinctive abilities, moves, and team synergies.

  • Fresh Encounters & Boss Fights: Face invading scorpions, spiders, lizards, and elite foes in handcrafted combat scenarios.

  • Dynamic Action Camera: A reactive camera system that zooms, shifts, and sweeps to frame every battle and platforming sequence.

  • Online & Couch Co-op: Seamlessly switch between solo play and cooperative sessions with friends at home or across the world.

  • Replayable Game Modes: Tackle the campaign, sharpen your skills in training, or battle rivals in PvP for endless gameplay variety.

  • Evolving Arenas: Battle in compact arenas that change conditions mid-match, forcing players to adapt quickly.
short_desc: Unleash your inner warrior in this high-octane 3D Beat 'Em Up! Team up with friends in 4-player local or online co-op to defend the Amphibilands. Master unique combat styles, dodge deadly hazards, and battle the Scorpion Army in a cinematic adventure expanding the Kulipari saga.
